name: Roland JUNO-Gi
description: Roland JUNO-Gi mobile synthesizer with digital recorder: the temporary Live Set (common, effects, four layers with their tone offsets, controller), the temporary Studio Set (common, effects, and every part's MIDI, Part and Tone Offset blocks) and the Solo Synth, from the temporary (edit-buffer) area of the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: JUNO-Gi MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, June 1, 2010)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from JUNO-Gi_MI.pdf (sha256 e77a6e8f914afb79424c83ab9a601c72d7d6549a5458e181d170bdec0cd0bcad). Model ID 00 00 4C, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Every block of the temporary area is laid out: the Temporary Live Set (10 00 00 00) and Temporary Studio Set (18 00 00 00) whole, the Setup (01 00 00 00), the System (02 00 00 00: common, mastering, controller) and the Solo Synth (04 00 00 00). Only the 256 User Live Sets (20 00 00 00 to 21 7F 00 00, the Temporary Live Set's layout each) are left out, as memories, not edit buffer.

There is no temporary tone, so nothing for noPull: the map has no tone parameters at all. A Live Set layer or a Studio Set part names a preset tone by Bank Select (Tone Bank Select MSB/LSB, Tone Program Number: MSB 87 LSB 0-6 tones, 86 rhythms, 0-63 and 121 GM, 120 GM rhythms; p1) and its Tone Offset block adjusts it, TONE meaning the tone's own value.

Presets list the Live Sets (Bank Select MSB 84, p1), recalled on the profile's channel, which must be the Live Set Main Channel (System Common 02 00 00 0B) for a Live Set to change. Tones (MSB 86/87, p1) are chosen per Studio Set part on other channels and are not listed.

Rows the manual prints with a range and no name (p12-17) are laid out under their offset: Live Set Common 00 39-00 40, Live Set Layer 00 2F-00 30 (two OFF/ON switches between Receive Modulation and Receive Expression, where the Studio Set Part has Receive Volume and Receive Pan) and 00 3A-00 41, Live Set Controller 00 1B-00 22, Studio Set Common 00 10 and 00 28-00 37.

The Studio Set has MFX settings and no MFX: its Common has MFX1-3 Control Channel and an MFX Structure (1-16), and each part an Output MFX Select (MFX1-MFX3), but its offset table (p10) lists Common, Chorus (00 04 00) and Reverb (00 06 00) and no MFX block, where the Live Set's lists MFX1 at 00 02 00 and MFX2 at 00 08 00. Nothing is laid out at the Studio Set's 00 02 00.

The Setup prints "Live Mode Octave Shift" and "Live Mode Keyboard Range Lower/Upper" without the "Side n" the rows around them carry; they are numbered 1-4 in printed order, which is Side 1-4. Both Tone Offset tables print "TVF Cutoff Velocty Sens" (sic).

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the front panel transmits as CC is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.tones: not in the address map: layers and parts select preset tones by Bank Select and offset them (Tone Offset blocks, laid out); the tones' own parameters are not addressable
coverage.notModelled: the User Live Sets (20 00 00 00 to 21 7F 00 00); nothing else in the map is left out
